deviation.description: An authenticated A4 insufficient_three_path_solution abstention wrote a valid zero-row, zero-column selected-observation parquet. The frozen A5 hint builder requires its input columns before it can produce the intended zero-hint fallback.

policy: Never alter an A4 output or its advertised hash.
For a nonempty A4 selection, make a byte-identical A5-input copy.
For an authenticated A4 abstention with zero rows and zero columns, write a separate zero-row copy with the canonical 29-column schema and dtypes.
Add no scientific row, identity evidence, threshold, reset, or hint.
Require the frozen hint builder to emit exactly zero hints and zero forced resets for an adapted abstention.
Require A5 and frozen A3 direct outputs to match exactly on frame, fish_id, source_index, hypothesis_id, X, Y, Z, and identity_segment for an adapted abstention.

replacement_execution.mode: fresh whole heldout rerun of all five preregistered windows
replacement_execution.overlapping_successful_artifacts: must be scientifically hash-identical to the quarantined attempt, including every geometry block parquet and status JSON; expected timestamp, runtime summary, process-record, and log drift are excluded
replacement_execution.failed_quarantine_gate: before preparation, verify every path, byte count, and SHA-256 in the 403-file FAILED_ATTEMPT_FINALIZED inventory; the finalized sidecar itself is the only excluded file

prelaunch_audit_blocks.reason: The v3 baseline authenticated advertised aggregate geometry output but did not enumerate every geometry block parquet and status JSON, and it pinned the failed-attempt sidecar without replaying its complete inventory.
